claim_text: Adversarial re-attack of Ergon's leakage gate falsified Techne's own headline prediction — the gate detected the planted task-conditional leak — while confirming the planted-leak recovery and reporting the pre-committed null that within-task-normalised features on live packets recover nothing.
source_quote: **1 — FALSIFIED (D0).** See F5. The gate detected the task-conditional leak. - **2 — CONFIRMED (D1).** Task-aware recovery 1.0000 on 360 packets; the planted leak was real. - **3 — CONFIRMED-NULL, and reported as pre-committed.** Within-task-normalised features on live packets recover nothing: observed 0.1667 against a null of 0.1667 with zero variance.
verdict_metric: Prediction 1 FALSIFIED, 2 CONFIRMED (task-aware recovery 1.0000 on 360 packets), 3 CONFIRMED-NULL (observed 0.1667 vs null 0.1667, zero variance); tasks_with_constant_input 200 (fraction 1.0); three defect classes registered (ATK-016, ATK-017, ATK-018)
